granicus-legistar.name: Legistar (Agenda LE)

api.notes: REST/OData at https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/{client}/... No auth needed for the clients tested (coralgables, doral, pinecrest, miamidade). Endpoint groups: Events, EventItems, Matters, MatterAttachments, MatterHistories, MatterTexts, MatterSponsors, Bodies, Persons, OfficeRecords, RollCalls, Votes, VoteTypes, Actions, Indexes. Events carry EventAgendaFile and EventMinutesFile PDF URLs plus EventInSiteURL. Supports $filter (substringof), $orderby, $top. Caveats seen: passed flags, votes and tallies were null for Doral and Pinecrest items (clerks do not finalize minutes in Legistar); miamidade client is stale (last event 2018-06-19). /matters/{id}/texts/{ver} returned null text for Pinecrest. Attachment PDFs live on legistar1.granicus.com, which blocks automated fetchers (robots), and LegislationDetail.aspx pages return 'Invalid parameters!' to non-browser clients.

granicus-legistar.robots: webapi.legistar.com allows automated reads (no robots block seen); legistar1.granicus.com attachment/agenda PDFs are robots-disallowed; <client>.legistar.com detail pages reject non-browser requests

notes: Vendor tally (primary agenda/minutes system): Granicus Legistar 3 (Coral Gables, Doral, Pinecrest); Granicus govMeetings/ViewPublisher 2 (South Miami, Sunny Isles Beach); Granicus-owned PrimeGov/OneMeeting 1 (Miami Beach); Granicus-owned NovusAGENDA 1 (North Miami Beach); CivicPlus Agenda Center 5 (Aventura, Hialeah, Opa-locka, Palmetto Bay, plus North Miami boards); CivicPlus CivicWeb 1 (Miami Gardens); eSCRIBE (OnBoard) 1 (Cutler Bay); CHAMP 1 (North Miami); in-house 6 (County govaction, School Board, Biscayne Park, El Portal, Medley, Virginia Gardens, Key Biscayne website; Medley and Miami Gardens use Laserfiche WebLink for minutes). Granicus therefore touches 10 of 21 bodies when video hosting (Key Biscayne, Palmetto Bay, Doral) is counted. Only one contract has a derivable expiration (Doral, 2028-09-30, derived from 'five additional years' after FY 2023-24). Hialeah 2025-099 and Pinecrest VOP1551 are dated approvals without end dates. Blockers: the shell cannot reach any government or vendor host (proxy CONNECT 403); the fetcher is robots-blocked on legistar1.granicus.com attachments (quotes, master agreements), <client>.granicus.com ViewPublisher, civicweb.net, miamibeachfl.primegov.com and cutlerbay-fl.gov meeting pages, so contract PDFs attached to Legistar items could not be read. Dates and costs recorded only from the body's own records; third-party summaries are flagged in notes.
